g.text: Safety stock raises the reorder point above mean lead-time demand

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Continuous-review illustration with fixed lead time and independent daily demand, approximated by a normal lead-time sum. Reorder on inventory position,
which includes on-order stock and subtracts backorders. The≈95% cycle-service probability is not fill rate. Lead-time variability, autocorrelation,
discrete units, and nonnormal tails would change this calculation.
